## Description
Briefly describe the purpose of this PR and what problem or feature it addresses.

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature / model / endpoint
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavior change
- [ ] `test`: Adding or updating test cases
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `ci`: CI/CD pipeline or workflow changes
- [ ] `chore`: Dependency updates, config tweaks

## Related Phase / Issue
- Closes / Relates to: Phase X / Issue #...

## Changes Made
- Summary of technical changes
- Files added / modified

## Verification & Testing
- [ ] Ran linter: `ruff check .` passed cleanly
- [ ] Ran automated tests: `pytest` (all tests passed)
- [ ] Verified Docker image builds locally: `docker build -t test .`
- [ ] Verified zero external MLflow dependency for unit/integration tests

## Quality Gate Checklist
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets or credentials
- [ ] Pinned dependencies in requirements.txt / requirements-dev.txt
- [ ] Clean git commit history following Conventional Commits format
